reading.body:
CoreSite's Milpitas facility occupies over 76,000 square feet as part of a nine-building Silicon Valley campus spanning more than 1.4 million square feet, though the power capacity of the individual building remains unspecified.

This property is held under a separate legal entity, a standard structure for real estate investment trusts to compartmentalize real estate holdings for financing and tax purposes. CoreSite, a subsidiary of American Tower Corporation, applies this model across its Silicon Valley campus, where multiple buildings share infrastructure in a single geographic cluster. The distributed structure means individual facility power and square footage are not fully itemized in public filings, making campus-level aggregation difficult.

The data confirms physical presence and square footage but does not specify power draw, cooling capacity, or the specific customers served at this location. Without power data, the facility's contribution to regional grid load and data center density in Silicon Valley cannot be measured from this entry alone.
